# Permit360

> Building-permit review for Israeli local and regional planning and building committees, and Permit360 Pro for
> engineers and architects preparing permit applications. Hebrew: בדיקת היתרי בנייה. Arabic: فحص رخص البناء. Russian: проверка разрешений на строительство.

Permit360 (https://permit360.kortexd.com) is a product of Kortex Digital Ltd (https://kortexd.com).

## What it does
- For planning committees (ועדות מקומיות לתכנון ובנייה / لجان التخطيط والبناء المحلية): checks a building-permit
  application against the applicable zoning plans (תב"ע / TABA / مخطط هيكلي), building rights, building lines, height
  and floors; every finding cites its source and a human reviewer decides. Permit workflow, deadlines, audit trail.
- Permit360 Pro, for engineers and architects (מהנדסים ואדריכלים / مهندسين ومعماريين): identifies the responsible
  committee from block and parcel (גוש וחלקה / gush helka / حوض وقسيمة) using the official planning-area boundaries;
  lists applicable plans, land use, building rights and restrictions; guides the application to submission readiness;
  an engineering assistant answers from the committee's own documents. Engineers and architects can register on the
  sign-in page.
- The system assists; permit decisions belong to the committee.
